prompts: Use case: scientific-educational. Create a polished landscape 1536x1024 3D scientific teaching illustration matching a graphene website: dark warm charcoal background, cream short labels, copper honeycomb carbon networks, restrained teal explanatory arrows, elegant studio lighting. Spacious readable layout, no charts or numeric measurements unless specifically requested. Carbon networks are connected hexagonal honeycomb sheets, with atoms and gaps exaggerated. The image is conceptual, not experimental photography. Two panels left to right connected by an arrow. Left: a compact graphite stack composed of about eight aligned copper honeycomb carbon sheets. Right: an isolated single honeycomb graphene sheet, separated from a smaller remaining stack to show one layer extracted. Clearly show stack vs exactly one layer. Text only: "Graphite: stacked sheets", "Graphene: one sheet", and above connecting arrow "Separate a layer". Do not show carbon turning into another substance.
